SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ここが漢江（ハンガン）ですよ！

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 저 유만 님... 근데 사람이 너무 많은 거 같은데요.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Yuman... But there are so many people.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 不过宥万… 这里人好多啊…

SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Юман... Но здесь так много людей.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Hey, no one’s paying attention to us!
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ええ、誰も私たちのことなんて気にしてませんよ！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Hei, gak ada yang memperhatikan kita!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ei, ninguém tá prestando atenção na gente!
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Эй, никто на нас не смотрит!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: And look, the cherry blossoms are beautiful.

SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Dan lihat, bunga sakuranya indah banget.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: E olha, as flores de cerejeira estão lindas.
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: И смотри, какие красивые цветы сакуры.

SCRIPT.PERSIAN: و ببینید، شکوفه های گیلاس زیبا هستند.

SCRIPT.THAI: ดอกซากุระสวยๆ...เหรอ?

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Is this your first time at the Han River?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 你这是第一次来汉江吧?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 你這是第一次來漢江吧?
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ini pertama kalinya kamu ke Sungai Han?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: É a sua primeira vez no Rio Han?
SCRIPT.FRENCH: C’est ta première fois à la rivière Han ?
SCRIPT.THAI: นี่เป็นครั้งแรกที่มาที่แม่น้ำฮันเหรอ?

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Yes! It’s my first time here!
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Iya! Ini pertama kaliku di sini!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Sim! É minha primeira vez aqui!
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Oui ! C’est la première fois que je viens ici !
SCRIPT.THAI: ใช่! ที่นี่เป็นครั้งแรกเลย!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: بله! اولین بار است که اینجا هستم!

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 여기 한강에 놀 것도 진짜 많아요!
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: There’s so much to do at the Han River!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 汉江好玩的地方可多了!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 漢江好玩的地方可多了!
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 漢江には楽しいものがたくさんあるんですよ！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Banyak banget yang bisa dilakukan di Sungai Han!

SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: На реке Хан столько всего интересного!
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Il y a tellement de choses à faire à la rivière Han !
SCRIPT.THAI: ที่แม่น้ำฮันมีอะไรให้ทำเยอะแยะเลย!
